payout_quote: All participants will receive $100 after completing this study. Parking and alternative transportation will also be covered by the study.
steps: Open the official UCLA recruitment flyer for the Music Stimulation study
Confirm eligibility: age 45+, English or Spanish speaking, not hearing impaired, cognitively normal or diagnosed with Lewy body dementia / Alzheimer's / MCI
Complete 1 remote visit and 2 in-person visits: 1-hour cognitive test, 1.5-hour MRI, 30-minute hearing test, 2-hour brain-wave recording while listening to music
Receive $100 after completing the study, with parking/transport covered
